description:
The factor that carries a price paid in a past month to the latest
    SETTLED month of the published repeat-sales house-price index: the
    postcode district's own series, else its local authority's, else the
    national series; forecast months are never used. Returns `factor`, the
    two index levels (`index_level_from`, `index_level_to`), `basis`
    (repeat_sales_district | repeat_sales_lad | repeat_sales_national),
    `current_period` (the month carried to, which trails the calendar by the
    registry's lag) and provenance. `status` is ok or index_unavailable: a
    price no published series covers has a null factor, never a stand-in 1.0.
    A factor of exactly 1.0 is real (a price from that month or later; see
    `reason`). The same carry the valuation applies to each comparable and to
    the property's own last sale. `postcode` is a full UK postcode or a
    district; `from_date` is YYYY-MM-DD; `lookback_years` (1–20) only sets
    how much of `monthly_series` comes back.
    UK only. Free.
name: time_adjustment
title: Index factor between two dates
